name: gooey-input
title: Gooey Input
description: A compact white search pill with a magnifier and placeholder. Clicking it springs open into a separate round icon button and a long input joined for a moment by a gooey bridge, then collapses again when left empty.
use: A page has little room for search and wants a compact control that opens only on demand.
avoid: Fixed pixel widths and a detached offset, so it can overflow narrow containers.
a11y: The icon-only trigger has no aria-label, and the motion ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single white pill sits on a black stage with a dark magnifier and the grey text Type to. Opened, it becomes a small white circle holding the magnifier plus a long white rounded field reading Type to search, with a thin liquid neck between them.
behaves: Clicking the pill springs it open: the icon slides into its own circle while the field stretches right, briefly held together by a gooey bridge. Leaving an empty field collapses it and clears the text.
customise: Placeholder, widths, offset, blur, value and open state are props, plus a classNames map per part; the icon and spring are fixed.
weight: light: A few nodes and one SVG filter; animation runs only on open and close.
